name: Exa
tagline: Neural web search API for finding relevant pages and content
description: Exa is a neural web search API that helps developers find relevant web pages and content using semantic search. It provides endpoints for searching, finding similar pages, and retrieving content from the web.

auth.details: API key via x-api-key header, self-serve signup

example.request: curl -X POST https://api.exa.ai/search -H "x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query": "latest AI research"}'

use_cases: find relevant web pages for a research query
find similar pages to a given URL
